heading: Advantages of AngularJS Web Development
text2: Knowledge and exposure to the right kind of projects of the right size determine the ability of teams. Our teams are credited with some of the best solutions.

items.title: Optimize Security
items.text: Server agnostic framework renders superior security.

items.title: Best for Developing Single Page App
items.text: Multiple challenges in developing single page applications are addressed effortlessly.

items.title: Two-way Data Binding
items.text: Rendering templates in plain HTML which are detected and changed automatically.

items.title: Material Design
items.text: The complete set of fully tested, easily accessible components for a unified and optimized design.

items.title: Command Line Interface
items.text: The high quality tool set that facilitates development.

items.title: Less Coding
items.text: The flexibility of developing applications with less code.

items.title: Testing Made Easy
items.text: Simplified and comprehensive testing reinforces the developers confidence in the developed modules.

items.title: Easy Maintenance
items.text: Lightweight and dynamic single page application, offers easy maintenance.

items.title: Improved Server Performance
items.text: With the support of caching and many other processes, it reduces the load on the server and improves the performance.
